subject: Science
stem: A car moving at a constant speed of 60 km/h changes its direction while going around a curve, even though its speed does not change. Since velocity includes direction, the car is undergoing:

options.option_text: Acceleration (because velocity, which includes direction, is changing)
No acceleration at all, since speed is constant

explanation: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity, and velocity is a vector (has both magnitude and direction) — so even at constant speed, a change in direction means the car is accelerating.
